rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something meets the required conditions or criteria.

example.english: This application appears to qualify for further review.
example.traditional: 呢份申請表符合條件，可以繼續審批。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 san1 cing2 biu2 fu4 hap6 tiu4 gin6 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 sam2 pai1

rows.note: Use this specifically when a competitor or team advances to the next round.

example.english: If we win this match, we qualify for the next round.
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 jeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 zau6 ceot1 sin3

rows.note: Use this construction when an action or qualification makes someone eligible or competent for a role or task.

example.english: This certificate allows me to qualify for a job teaching children.
example.traditional: 呢張證書令我有資格教小朋友。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 zing3 syu1 ling6 ngo5 jau5 zi1 gaak3 gaau3 siu2 pang4 jau5

rows.note: Use this when qualifying means limiting, restricting, or placing conditions on something, including an assertion.

example.english: This extra note serves to qualify the statement by limiting its scope.
example.traditional: 呢句補充限制咗個講法嘅適用範圍。
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 bou2 cung1 haan6 zai3 zo2 go3 gong2 faat3 ge3 sik1 jung6 faan6 wai4
